description: Land Acquisition - Expansion of Midigama Market D/S Division. Weligama 2).Correction Paper - Agalawatta D/S Division. (Section -07)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains two separate notices under Section 7 of the Act detailing specific land acquisitions for public purposes (expansion of Midigama Market), including descriptions of the land parcels, claimants, and procedures for interested parties to file compensation claims. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category as it deals with government land acquisition processes, property descriptions, and related administrative procedures.
